place.name: River Suir at Port of Waterford, Belview

status_claim.claim: MARA records a material-amendment application received on 9 September 2026. It has not yet been assessed, and a statutory public consultation may be required.

amendment_claim.claim: The applicant seeks to remove Specific Condition 28 so licensed marine site-investigation surveys may take place between 1 November and 31 January.

existing_condition.claim: Specific Condition 28 prohibits the permitted maritime usage between 1 November and 31 January annually to reduce disturbance to known fish spawning along the survey route.

evidence_divergence.regulator_position: MARA previously retained the condition under the precautionary principle because site-specific inshore fisheries evidence was limited and absence of records should not be treated as absence of fish.
evidence_divergence.applicant_position: The applicant's newly submitted fisheries assessment argues that the works fall outside relevant spawning areas and would not materially affect habitat, fish movement, underwater noise or water quality.

sources.support: Application type, received date, applicant, place, requested amendment, current applied status and warning that assessment and consultation may follow.
Applicant's detailed request, existing condition, account of MARA's earlier reasoning and applicant's new assessment.
Parent licence, original activity, location and determination date.

commercial_signal.opportunity: A bounded, version-controlled amendment chronology linking the original licence, submissions, conditions, new evidence, consultation and determination.
commercial_signal.next_action: Prepare a two-page prototype chronology and consider a fixed-fee amendment-tracking pilot after MARA opens consultation or publishes its assessment.

retrieval_result.claim: Direct review of the Anglian Water news source was prevented by an access restriction.

records.coverage_implication: Treat Anglian Water as unchecked for this review period. Retry through an accessible official feed or sitemap; do not create environmental-event records from secondary reporting alone.

commercial_signal.opportunity: Source-health monitoring that distinguishes retrieval failure from a verified no-change result.
commercial_signal.next_action: Retain an unresolved source-health alert until an official source can be reviewed.
